items.title: Walmart Earnings Top, But Stock Tumbles On Weak U.S. Sales, Guidance
items.summary: Walmart earnings beat, but U.S. same-store sales were the weakest in six years while the Dow retail giant guided lower. WMT stock tumbled.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Walmart, Strategy, Coty
items.summary: ↘️ Coty (COTY): The beauty company reported a steeper loss and guided for a drop in sales in the current quarter. Shares fell over 7% before the bell. ↘️ Moderna (MRNA): Shares pulled back 10% in premarket trading following yesterday’s 177% rally— the biggest gain for any stock in the S&P 500 in the past 25 years.

items.title: Evercore ISI Names Three Top Discount Retail Stocks for the Second Half
items.summary: Evercore ISI has selected three discount retailers as its preferred stocks within the global retail, apparel and luxury brands sector, pointing to opportunities for stronger performance during the second half of the year. The firm’s assessment focuses on companies where comparable sales trends, easier comparison periods or operational improvements could provide meaningful support despite an uncertain consumer and market backdrop.
